import errno,json,os,pathlib,socket
memory_kib=int(next(line.split()[1] for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('MemTotal:')))
fs=os.statvfs('/')
attempts=[]
for host in ('1.1.1.1','8.8.8.8'):
    try:
        connection=socket.create_connection((host,443),timeout=2)
        connection.close()
        attempts.append({'errno':0,'connected':True})
    except OSError as exc:
        attempts.append({'errno':exc.errno,'connected':False})
print(json.dumps({'cpu_count':os.cpu_count(),'memory_total_bytes':memory_kib*1024,'rootfs_capacity_bytes':fs.f_blocks*fs.f_frsize,'interfaces':sorted(p.name for p in pathlib.Path('/sys/class/net').iterdir()),'external_tcp_attempts':attempts},separators=(',',':')))
